# Split lines and group every 5 lines as a record
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in ocr_text.split("\n") if ln.strip()]
records = []
buf = []
for ln in lines:
    # Skip section headers
    if ln in {"Scribe County Public Library", "Title", "Author", "Publisher", "Genre", "Status", "Books", "Young Children's", "Middle Grade", "Young Adult"}:
        continue
    buf.append(ln)
    if len(buf) == 5:
        records.append(buf)
        buf = []

# Build DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["Title","Author","Publisher","Genre","Status"])

# Filter Rick Riordan books
riordan = df[df["Author"].str.lower().str.contains("rick riordan")]

# Consider not on shelves: Checked Out or Overdue
not_on_shelves = riordan[riordan["Status"].str.lower().isin(["checked out","overdue"])]

print("Number of Rick Riordan books not currently on the library’s shelves:", len(not_on_shelves))
print("\nList of titles and their status:")
print(not_on_shelves[["Title","Status"]])
